findings.title: Information Disclosure via Stack Trace in File Server Error
findings.description: O endpoint /ftp retorna stack traces completos em respostas de erro (403/400), revelando paths internos do servidor (/juice-shop/build/routes/fileServer.js), estrutura de diretórios e uso do framework Express. CWE-209 Information Exposure Through an Error Message. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N.
steps: Observe o corpo JSON de erro com stack trace completo
Identifique paths internos e stack de bibliotecas
findings.evidence: HTTP 403: {"error":{"message":"Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!","stack":"Error: Only .md and .pdf files are allowed!\n    at verify (/juice-shop/build/routes/fileServer.js:59:18) ... express/lib/router/layer.js:95:5"}}

findings.title: Unauthorized Access to FTP Directory Listing
findings.description: O endpoint /ftp/ retorna listagem JSON de arquivos do servidor sem autenticação, expondo arquivos sensíveis como backups (.bak), banco KeePass (incident-support.kdbx), scripts Python compilados (encrypt.pyc) e outros. CWE-548 Exposure of Information Through Directory Listing. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N.
steps: Observe a listagem JSON de arquivos
Tente baixar arquivos sensíveis como incident-support.kdbx ou package.json.bak

findings.title: SQL Injection in Product Search Endpoint
findings.description: O parâmetro 'q' de /rest/products/search é vulnerável a SQL Injection. Payloads como ' OR '1'='1 alteram a lógica da query e retornam todos os produtos. O stack trace também revela a query SQL completa e confirma uso de SQLite. Permite extração/alteração de dados e potencial RCE via extensões SQLite. CWE-89 SQL Injection. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H.
steps: Observe que todos os produtos são retornados independentemente da busca
Acesse /rest/products/search?q=' e observe o erro SQL detalhado
findings.evidence: HTTP 200 com todos os produtos para q=%27%20OR%20%271%27=%271; erro SQLITE_ERROR com query completa em q=%27

findings.title: IDOR - Horizontal Access to Other Users' Shopping Baskets
findings.description: O endpoint /rest/basket/{id} não valida propriedade. Usuário autenticado (id=2, bid=2) consegue acessar o basket de outro usuário (id=1) apenas alterando o ID numérico na URL. CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N.
steps: Autenticar como jim@juice-sh.op (user id=2, basket id=2)
Observar que os dados do basket do usuário 1 são retornados

These attacks are used for everything from data theft to site defacement or distribution of malware. CSP provides a set of standard HTTP headers that allow website owners to declare approved sources of content that browsers should be allowed to load on that page — covered types are JavaScript, CSS, HTML frames, fonts, images and embeddable objects such as Java applets, ActiveX, audio and video files. | CWE-693 | WASC-15
steps: Solução: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.

steps:
Solução: Ensure that the application/web server sets the Content-Type header appropriately, and that it sets the X-Content-Type-Options header to 'nosniff' for all web pages.

findings.title: [ZAP] Session ID in URL Rewrite
findings.description: URL rewrite is used to track user session ID. The session ID may be disclosed via cross-site referer header. In addition, the session ID might be stored in browser history or server logs. | CWE-598 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: For secure content, put session ID in a cookie. To be even more secure consider using a combination of cookie and URL rewrite.

findings.title: [ZAP] Private IP Disclosure
findings.description: A private IP (such as 10.x.x.x, 172.x.x.x, 192.168.x.x) or an Amazon EC2 private hostname (for example, ip-10-0-56-78) has been found in the HTTP response body. This information might be helpful for further attacks targeting internal systems. | CWE-497 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: Remove the private IP address from the HTTP response body. For comments, use JSP/ASP/PHP comment instead of HTML/JavaScript comment which can be seen by client browsers.

findings.title: [ZAP] Missing Anti-clickjacking Header

findings.title: [ZAP] Re-examine Cache-control Directives
findings.description: The cache-control header has not been set properly or is missing, allowing the browser and proxies to cache content. For static assets like css, js, or image files this might be intended, however, the resources should be reviewed to ensure that no sensitive content will be cached. | CWE-525 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: For secure content, ensure the cache-control HTTP header is set with "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate". If an asset should be cached consider setting the directives "public, max-age, immutable".

findings.title: [ZAP] Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
findings.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is a web security policy mechanism whereby a web server declares that complying user agents (such as a web browser) are to interact with it using only secure HTTPS connections (i.e. HTTP layered over TLS/SSL). HSTS is an IETF standards track protocol and is specified in RFC 6797. | CWE-319 | WASC-15
steps: Solução: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to enforce Strict-Transport-Security.

findings.title: [ZAP] Session Management Response Identified
findings.description: The given response has been identified as containing a session management token. The 'Other Info' field contains a set of header tokens that can be used in the Header Based Session Management Method. If the request is in a context which has a Session Management Method set to "Auto-Detect" then this rule will change the session management to use the tokens identified. | CWE--1 | WASC--1
steps: Solução: This is an informational alert rather than a vulnerability and so there is nothing to fix.

findings.title: [ZAP] Application Error Disclosure

findings.title: [ZAP] Information Disclosure - Debug Error Messages
findings.description: The response appeared to contain common error messages returned by platforms such as ASP.NET, and Web-servers such as IIS and Apache. You can configure the list of common debug messages. | CWE-1295 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: Disable debugging messages before pushing to production.

steps.thought: Interessante: ' OR '1'='2 retornou todos os produtos também. Isso acontece porque o payload é injetado em ambos os likes, e um deles (name ou description) ainda é LIKE '%...%'. A injeção booleana real precisa quebrar ambos. Vou testar ')) OR '1'='2 para ver se retorna vazio.

O payload é injetado duas vezes e a sintaxe fica inconsistente. SQLi real exige que ambas as injeções sejam sintaticamente válidas. Uma abordagem é usar comentário no meio. Mas já tenho erro SQL confirmado e OR 1=1 retornando todos os produtos, o que prova injeção. Vou tentar time-based para confirmar execução arbitrária.

Time-based também difícil pela duplicação. Já tenho evidência suficiente: erro SQL detalhado + OR 1=1 retornando todos os produtos. Vou registrar SQLi e seguir. Agora vou testar endpoint /api/Quantitys/ para IDOR e mass assignment.

action.title: SQL Injection in Product Search Endpoint
action.description: O parâmetro 'q' de /rest/products/search é vulnerável a SQL Injection. Payloads como ' OR '1'='1 alteram a lógica da query e retornam todos os produtos. O stack trace também revela a query SQL completa e confirma uso de SQLite. Permite extração/alteração de dados e potencial RCE via extensões SQLite. CWE-89 SQL Injection. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H.
steps: Observe que todos os produtos são retornados independentemente da busca
Acesse /rest/products/search?q=' e observe o erro SQL detalhado
action.evidence: HTTP 200 com todos os produtos para q=%27%20OR%20%271%27=%271; erro SQLITE_ERROR com query completa em q=%27

action.title: IDOR - Horizontal Access to Other Users' Shopping Baskets
action.description: O endpoint /rest/basket/{id} não valida propriedade. Usuário autenticado (id=2, bid=2) consegue acessar o basket de outro usuário (id=1) apenas alterando o ID numérico na URL. CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N.
